## What does this contribution do?

Describe the change in plain English, and say which official research test or shared infrastructure it supports.

## Related prior work

Link Issues, Discussions, predecessor experiments, other authors' research, and relevant external publications. Explain how this contribution builds on them.

## Contributor credit

List **every human contributor and their specific role**, including people who proposed the idea, designed the experiment, wrote code, reproduced results, or reviewed findings. Link original submissions where possible.

## AI assistance and human intervention

Which AI systems or coding assistants materially helped? What did humans check, decide, or correct?

## Evidence and reproducibility

What did you test? Include commands, synthetic inputs, versions, observed outputs, limitations, and links to allowed evidence. If no experiment was run, say so.

## Safety, privacy, and rights

- [ ] I have authority to submit these materials and have reviewed [the Apache 2.0 license](../LICENSE) and [contributor-credit policy](../CREDIT_AND_ATTRIBUTION.md).
- [ ] No secrets, confidential employer information, customer records, or private household data are disclosed without authorization.
- [ ] I have not presented a simulation or partial success as a passing result of either complete test.
- [ ] I have credited prior work and disclosed material AI assistance.

For material experimental claims, use [the research record template](../research/RECORD_TEMPLATE.md) and [the discovery process](../docs/DISCOVERY_PROCESS.md). Patent-sensitive contributors should obtain qualified advice *before* publishing.
